targets.title: Improving Quantitative Studies of International Conflict: A Conjecture.
targets.evidence_quote: Beck, King, and Zeng (2000) offer both a sweeping critique of the quantitative security studies field and a bold new direction for future research.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We replicate and extend their analysis by estimating a more complete logit model and comparing it both to a neural network and to a linear discriminant analysis.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Our work reveals that neural networks do not perform substantially better than either the logit or the linear discriminant estimators.
